newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen opening mixed to higher.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen opening mixed to higher.

text.p: U.S. blue chips are expected to open mixed but then continue the upward momentum from Friday's rally when the Dow industrials gained 130 points to 7435.
The 30-year U.S. Treasuries are off 5/32 at a yield of 6.79 percent. The Standard & Poor's futures index is off 0.15 at 862.35.

"I don't think we won't have a followthrough on the momentum from Friday," said Joseph Bartel, chief investment strategist at Fahnestock & Co. "I would think there is very little to have the market stub its toe."
